description:
Top floor · Two double bedrooms · Two bathrooms · Fully furnished

Modern top-floor apartment situated on Highbridge, Gosforth. The property comprises an entrance hallway, stairs to the top floor, private entrance, hallway, large living room, breakfasting kitchen, master bedroom with ensuite, second double bedroom and a family bathroom. The property has recently undergone major refurbishment having been fully redecorated, new flooring throughout, and both bathrooms being updated. The kitchen also benefits from an integrated washing machine, dishwasher and fridge freezer.
